facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; keep USD 5,000 a month or half your earnings in foreign currency.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks open an export dollar account (ESFCA) alongside your rupee account.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways like Safepay and PayFast ask for an NTN and business bank account.
facts.L1_registration: No business registration needed; just register with FBR for an NTN.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your NTN is your CNIC number; enrol free online on FBR Iris.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Export income: 0.25% final tax if PSEB-registered, otherwise 1%.
facts.L4_vat_gst: Services are taxed by provinces; Sindh exempts exported IT services.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law in force yet; your clients' laws (like GDPR) matter.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online contracts are legal; consumer protection is mainly provincial.
facts.L7_incentives: Register with PSEB (Rs 1,000 a year) to cut export tax to 0.25%.

watch_out.text: The low export tax counts as final only if you file your tax return.
Register with PSEB to pay 0.25% instead of 1% on export income.
You can't withdraw foreign-currency cash inside Pakistan.
